unresolved_relationships: The ditto source for b004 is uncertain

coverage.finding: The pencil folio label '5b' with a short underline is at the top left. The supplied label is fol. 5b.

The ink line reads 'ff.1-133(also remains of earlier foliation of parts separately), in various hand. Dated Uttarakāṇḍa S.1824', with dots under ṇḍ. The left-pointing ink arrow continues across the gutter to the c. 277 row on fol. 6 ('Full text … 1777 : 133'). The attachment is probable, not secure. 'hand' versus 'hands' remains uncertain.

The ink line reads 'two MSS., (1) of story of Rāma, (2) of a philosophical work.' There is no arrow. It is level with the b. 68 row on fol. 6, and the candidate correctly leaves the attachment uncertain.

This is the faint pencil line with a tick above and a tick-like mark before 'c.'. It reads 'c. 343(1). Do, I, i, + do by do., ff.9-27. n.d.: 19: 5/10: D.' The double-headed arrow crosses the gutter near the c. 127(3)/'Son of Himmativarman' rows on fol. 6. The ditto source is unresolved. The fields conflated the folio range with the column count (see changes).
The ink line reads 'ff.49-51(9 ff.m.), adhy. i.102-vii of Bālakāṇḍa'. Its arrow corresponds to a left-margin arrow at the c. 134(1) row on fol. 6. The readings '49' and 'adhy.' remain uncertain.
The ink line reads 'ff.1-45(ll./11.31-36), Saṃv. 1816'. Its arrow crosses the gutter at the c. 134(4) row. The parenthetical remains uncertain.
The ink line reads 'ff.1-22(in 58), Bālakāṇḍa, and ff.1-24, Ayodhyākāṇḍa'. Its arrow corresponds to the '←' at c. 134(3)a on fol. 6.

The ink line runs nearly to the gutter. Its arrow is level with c. 134(3)b on fol. 6. The end of this same line is visible as a fragment ('…rmar. ←') at the left edge of the fol. 6 image, so it is the same block, not a separate record.

The slanted pencil memo 'get cord' is underlined. A faint pencil stroke runs toward the gutter, where the facing page has the d. 947 row. The same memo is visible as a fragment at the left edge of the fol. 6 image. The target of the memo is unresolved.

changes.reason: The folio range in the text and the '19' in the date/extent/lines/script column are separate written items. They are kept apart rather than merged. The meaning of '19' as a leaf count is only a probable interpretation, by analogy with the column pattern on fols. 5 and 6.

unresolved.issue: Two things are unresolved: (1) the faint pencil readings '343(1)', '19' and '5/10'; (2) which fol. 6 entry 'Do' and 'do by do.' repeat, and where the double-headed arrow inserts the entry (between c. 127(3) and c. 128(1)?).
unresolved.next_check: Compare at higher contrast with the fol. 6 rows c. 127(3) to c. 128(1) and the arrow head in the fol. 6 shelfmark column.

unresolved.issue: There is no connecting arrow. Attachment to b. 68 is based on line level only.
unresolved.next_check: Check the fol. 6 b. 68 row for any reference mark.

unresolved.issue: The reading 'ff.49-51' appears inconsistent with '(9 ff.m.)'. The first digit may be misread.
unresolved.next_check: Inspect the first numeral at native resolution near x≈420–520, y≈2530.

unresolved.issue: It is unknown which entry the memo 'get cord' and its stroke relate to.
unresolved.next_check: Trace the pencil stroke across the gutter on the fol. 6 image near the d. 947 row.

review.boundary_review: The gutter lies at about x 3150–3160. Everything to its right (d. 9.., d. 5.., cats. Brahm.., ✓c. 2.., ✓c. 1.., d., and a pencil curve near the bottom right at y≈4900) belongs to the facing fol. 6 and is not transcribed as target records. Fragments of b008 and b009 that appear at the left edge of the fol. 6 image are the same target blocks, not duplicates. The arrow attachments to fol. 6 entries are probable at most. The b003 and b004 relationships remain uncertain.

region_review.top: The folio label '5b' is at the top left. The rest of the top is blank ruled paper with faint show-through only.
region_review.middle: b002–b007 are present, one line each. The arrows at the right of b002 and b004–b007 are recorded as annotations and relationships. The b004 tick marks are noted.
region_review.bottom: b008 is present. b009 'get cord' is in pencil at the lower right. The rest of the page down to the lower edge is image-reviewed blank apart from show-through.
region_review.left_margin: No marginal writing apart from the starts of the lines and the b004 tick.
region_review.right_margin: The arrows and the pencil stroke near the gutter are accounted for. The fol. 6 shelfmark column beyond the gutter is excluded as a facing page.
region_review.interlinear: The only interlinear mark is the tick above 'c.' in b004. No cancellations or interlinear insertions are observed.
